passive.name: Heartfelt Caress
passive.text: When the equipper's HP decreases, their **Ice Sheer DMG** increases by **6/7/8/9/10%**, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 25s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. When the equipper's HP falls to 50% of Max HP or below, CRIT Rate increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: Caged Fire
passive.text: The equipper's **Fire DMG** increases by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%**. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%** for 5s.

passive.name: Summoning Arcanum
passive.text: When the equipper activates an **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's DMG by **4/4.6/5.2/5.8/6.4%**, up to 3 stacks, and lasting 20s. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by **6.5/7.5/8.5/9.4/10.4%**.

passive.name: Cloud Flow
passive.text: CRIT Rate increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**. When the equipper launches an **EX Special Attack**, the character gains 1 stack of **Qingming Companion** effect, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 15s. On entering combat, immediately gain 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of the **Qingming Companion** effect increases the equipper's **Ether DMG** by **8/9.2/10.4/11.6/12.8%**, and increases Ultimate and EX Special Attack **Ether Sheer DMG** by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

passive.name: Easy Strides
passive.text: When launching a **Chain Attack** or **Ultimate**, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect. Each stack increases the equipper's Sheer Force by **80/92/104/116/128**, stacking up to 3 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Ingenious Craft
passive.text: Upon launching an **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by **16/18.4/20.8/23.2/25.6%** for 12s. Additionally, if the target's current HP is below 50% of their Max HP, **EX Special Attack** DMG increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

substatLine: CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > HP% > ATK% = Flat HP
skillPriority: Special Attack > Chain Attack > Basic Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Crushing Strike
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing **Ice DMG**.
On the 3rd hit, Yidhari recovers 10% HP.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack to activate:
Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When Basic Attack is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer attack in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP.
At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of **Basic Attack: Crushing Strike**. The DMG of a **Basic Attack: Crushing Strike** triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%.
At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press Basic Attack to chain early into the finishing smash.

entries.name: Frost's Crushing Weight
entries.text:
While charging or spinning during **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace**, if hit by an enemy, Yidhari can block with her tentacles, reducing the DMG taken by 25%.
If charging or not yet at full charge, Yidhari counterattacks with her tentacles, returning to the charging stance and instantly gaining 1 charge level, while also dealing **Ice DMG** to enemies ahead.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing Basic Attack makes Yidhari immediately unleash the finishing slam of **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace** based on her current charge level.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing Special Attack or EX Special Attack makes Yidhari unleash a **Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit** that is guaranteed to trigger Surging Cold.

entries.name: Dodge: Dreamshift
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Frostbloom Impact
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Strike forward, dealing **Ice DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Icehaul Reverb
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Frostshock Reinforcement
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Flashquake Rejection
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Glacial Onslaught
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Execute an ice shard hammer attack against enemies in front, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Cease Thoughts
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing **Ice DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Frost Coil
entries.text:
With enough Adrenaline, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Perform two consecutive upward strikes, then release an icy mist, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
If EX Special Attack: Frost Coil hits an enemy, Yidhari recovers HP at the end of the skill equal to 33% of her missing HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit
entries.text:
Press Special Attack or EX Special Attack while charging or spinning during **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace**, or press Dodge while holding Basic Attack to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing **Ice DMG**.
When the skill's attack collides with an enemy's attack, it triggers Surging Cold.
If the skill hits a Stunned enemy, and with sufficient Adrenaline, it triggers Crushing Pursuit.
Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit instantly raises the charge level to maximum.
During this skill, press Basic Attack and Yidhari will immediately unleash the finishing slam of **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace** based on the current charge level.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush
entries.text:
When triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit, and with enough Adrenaline, press EX Special Attack or Basic Attack to activate:
Dash forward with an upward attack, then leap into the air before delivering a powerful downward smash, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
If **EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush** hits an enemy, Yidhari heals at the end of the skill for 33% of her missing HP.
If the skill is used after Surging Cold, it grants an additional 15 Adrenaline. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
After using this skill, press Basic Attack to immediately unleash the finishing slam of **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace** based on the current charge level.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rows.label: EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush DMG Multiplier
Additional Ability Icy Tentacle DMG Multiplier
EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush Daze Multiplier

entries.name: Chain Attack: Frostbound Oath
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike against enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
If inside **Ether Veil: Wellspring**, tentacles join in the assault, further enhancing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rows.label: DMG Multiplier in Ether Veil: Wellspring
Daze Multiplier in Ether Veil: Wellspring

entries.name: Ether Veil: Wellspring
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, the final hit of **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace**, **EX Special Attack: Frost Coil**, **EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush**, and **Chain Attack: Frostbound Oath** will consume 3,000 Decibels to activate an **Ether Veil: Wellspring**. While **Ether Veil: Wellspring** is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5% for 30s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 300s.
While Yidhari is within **Ether Veil: Wellspring**, the charge speed of **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace** increases, and HP is consumed faster during charging.

entries.name: Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
entries.text:
After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate **Ether Veil: Wellspring**, press Ultimate within 30s to activate:
Deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive **Ice DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Each time Yidhari expends Decibels to activate an **Ether Veil: Wellspring**, she can use **Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret** once.

entries.name: Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection
entries.text:
Yidhari gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All **Ice DMG** dealt by Yidhari deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier. When Yidhari enters battle, she immediately gains 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to **100%**. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Narrative Completion
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Stun** or **Support** character:
When Yidhari's HP falls below 50%, CRIT DMG increases by 30% and DMG taken is reduced by 25%.
While Yidhari is within **Ether Veil: Wellspring**, she gains the following additional effect:
After the level 3 charged attack of Yidhari's **Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace** or **EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush**, an icy tentacle is summoned to attack, dealing extra damage. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
The above skill is considered an **EX Special Attack**, the DMG multiplier increases based on the EX Special Attack's level.

entries.name: The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss
entries.text:
The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's **EX Special Attack** is reduced by 10.
After using **EX Special Attack: Frost Coil** or **EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush**, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another **EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush**. The HP restored by this **EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush** is increased by 100% of the original value.
Yidhari's **Basic Attacks** and **EX Special Attacks** ignore 20% of targets' **Ice RES**.

entries.name: Who Lingers Here, Lost in Thought?
entries.text: Yidhari's CRIT DMG increases by 40%. Triggering **Surging Cold** or **Crushing Pursuit** grants Adrenaline regen of 0.5/s for up to 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

entries.name: A Story Without an Audience
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Blooming in Silence
entries.text:
Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for **Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection**.
While in **Ether Veil: Wellspring**, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.

entries.name: This Solace Is Real
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: At Last, a Peaceful Dream
entries.text:
After Yidhari spends Decibels to activate or extend **Ether Veil: Wellspring**, she gains **Erudition** for 30s.
While **Erudition** is active, her Sheer DMG increases by 25%. Also, upon taking fatal DMG for the first time, her HP is reduced to at most 1, and for the next 5s, she cannot be defeated and will restore 25% HP over time.
